# 6.7(c)-SCOUT — empty `@generated` barrel `lint:arch` probe

**Date:** 2026-08-19 · **Status:** Option **(b)** — no linter-config change required.
**Item:** Wave C `6.7(c)-SCOUT` (ADR-0050 / HEX-025).
**Baseline:** `origin/main` @ `4142426860be22faf661519b95c517555406ed1c`
(`feat(prompt-compiler): list every port in grounded prompts (#539)`).
**This PR does not implement 6.7(c).** The six barrels stay in the committed tree.

Locators are durable (file + command), not line numbers.

---

## 0. Verdict

`yarn lint:arch` **stays green (exit 0)** after a **local** deletion of the six
empty `@generated` `export {}` layer barrels in `packages/core-domain` and
`packages/runtime`. No change to `.architecture/invariants/linter-config.yaml`
or any `tools/arch-linter` reader is required for 6.7(c) to open.

This is plan option **(b)**.

There was **no red output**. The command did not fail.

---

## 2. Probe procedure

Worktree was a clean checkout of `origin/main`. Copies were made with `cp`
(not `git checkout` / `git restore`). Deletion was local only.

```
PROBE_DIR=/tmp/6-7c-scout-mdWs0M

FILES=(
  packages/core-domain/src/domain/index.ts
  packages/core-domain/src/application/index.ts
  packages/core-domain/src/infrastructure/index.ts
  packages/runtime/src/domain/index.ts
  packages/runtime/src/application/index.ts
  packages/runtime/src/infrastructure/index.ts
)

for f in "${FILES[@]}"; do
  mkdir -p "$PROBE_DIR/$(dirname "$f")"
  cp "$f" "$PROBE_DIR/$f"
done

for f in "${FILES[@]}"; do
  rm "$f"
done
```

`git status --porcelain` after deletion (the six paths only):

```
 D packages/core-domain/src/application/index.ts
 D packages/core-domain/src/domain/index.ts
 D packages/core-domain/src/infrastructure/index.ts
 D packages/runtime/src/application/index.ts
 D packages/runtime/src/domain/index.ts
 D packages/runtime/src/infrastructure/index.ts
```

Precondition for a clean worktree: `yarn turbo run build --filter=@hexagen/arch-linter`
(exit 0). `yarn lint:arch` refuses to run and exits 2 if `tools/arch-linter/dist/cli.js`
is missing — that is a “could not run” status, not a violation.

Then:

```
yarn lint:arch
```

## 5. What this unblocks, and what it does not

- **6.7(c) may open** after this note is on `main`. Deleting these six barrels
  does not redden `yarn lint:arch` on current `main`.
- **Do not treat this as a deletion PR.** The barrels are still present.
- ADR-0050 Consequences still say the linter “must tolerate opted-out layers.”
  This probe shows the current linter already does **not** require those six
  files to exist. Option (a) (a `linter-config.yaml` layer-less-context flag)
  is therefore not needed for this delete set.
- 6.7(c) still owns any `context.yaml` `layers.*` cleanup for
  `core-domain` / `runtime` if the implementing PR drops the vestigial folders
  (ADR-0057: curated ownership registry — do not add entries just because a
  file exists; drop only if the implementing PR decides those layer lists no
  longer describe ownership).
